children: Machi Big Brother sold BAYC #950 and BAYC #5310 in over-the-counter transactions to Adam Weitsman. According to Odaily, Yuga Grails OTC said it had facilitated the deals, naming Weitsman as the buyer and Machi Big Brother as the seller.

Weitsman later thanked Grails OTC, PPMan and Quit on X for helping arrange the transactions, and singled out figge for providing assistance during a market downturn. He said many deals might not have been completed without their help.

title: Machi Big Brother Sells BAYC #950 and BAYC #5310 in OTC Deals
